settings.cuesHint: One per line, "MM:SS  text" — announced to the GM when the clock reaches that time. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.

timer.gmOnly: Only the GM can control the Flip Timer.
timer.cueRejected: Flip Timer ignored unreadable cue line(s): {lines}. Each cue needs "MM:SS  text".
timer.cueInvalid: A cue needs a time of "MM:SS" (or seconds) and some text.
